work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Pass 31 remains independently occupied and is not modified or treated as completed by this handoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of seven same-model harness observations from the pinned Mercury Harness Benchmark V2 complete 140-trial matrix. W1 records only external-verifier resolution counts and preserves the one-rollout design, verifier-only recovery path, CPU-policy discrepancy, provider-route uncertainty, and unresolved harness-version metadata without ranking or causal interpretation.
discovery_pass.environment: Harbor + fresh E2B single-container sandbox per trial

source_known_dimensions: same source-reported z-ai/glm-5.3-flash model ID through OpenRouter
fresh E2B single-container sandbox per trial
concurrency two with harness order rotated by task
same task-specific CPU declarations across harnesses
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact service-side GLM-5.3-Flash checkpoint behind OpenRouter
exact upstream package/source revisions for the named harness installations are not established by the aggregate study table
harness-default reasoning, prompts, context management, temperatures, tools and termination behavior intentionally differ
seven trials used verifier-only replay after Harbor artifact-collection stalls, but the aggregate study does not report a per-harness recovery count
the intended fixed 10-CPU override was not applied; 17 tasks used 2 CPUs and 3 tasks used 8 CPUs

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admit factual externally verified resolution counts while preserving source-class differences and all published protocol deviations

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The intended fixed 10-CPU environment was not applied. Generated task declarations used 2 CPUs for 17 tasks and 8 CPUs for 3 tasks. Because the same task declaration applies across harnesses, W1 preserves rather than normalizes this discrepancy.

After Harbor artifact collection stalled post-agent completion, seven outcomes were recovered by applying the saved patch in a fresh verifier-only sandbox. Model inference was not rerun. The aggregate source does not provide the per-harness recovery count, so W1 leaves it unknown per observation.
Each task-harness pair has one canonical rollout. W1 does not infer uncertainty or replicate results.
OpenRouter generation records reported zero total_cost despite nonzero native token telemetry. W1 therefore admits resolution only and does not promote the zero cost figure.

After the pass-37 branch was created from aad1a22d, main advanced to 3074a6d8 via documentation-only PR #131. The concurrent change did not touch system observations, generated registry views, or the validation workflow; pass-37 registry generation remained based on the 275-observation checkpoint.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: Mercury V2 cost ranking and cost-per-resolved comparisons
non_admission_dispositions.reason: Provider reconciliation is incomplete for some trials, a shared credential was used, and Codex has a documented zero-cost accounting anomaly. These telemetry fields are preserved by the primary source but are outside this factual resolution admission.
The source explicitly states these are study-defined static selection strata rather than official FeatBench difficulty labels.
V1 uses a different model and task block; the primary source itself warns that cross-study percentage changes are descriptive, not a controlled longitudinal effect.

results.detail: Neutral registry regeneration, repository validation, post-closure validators, both pass-37 record-specific admission checks, and the existing live admission loop succeeded.
